claims.text: The proposed model combines the gating mechanism and tensor product concepts to learn long-term dependencies and improve interaction between input and hidden layers.
By integrating LSTM and GRU architectures with tensor products, the model achieves better performance in language modeling tasks compared to baseline models.
The combination of these concepts allows the model to represent hidden layers with more powerful operations, enhancing its ability to capture complex relationships in data.
